title: 1 CUBE = 1 NEURON
brain:
A single neuron.
Cell body. Axon. Dendrites.
It fires or it doesn't.
Binary. One cube.
desc:
This is where it starts. 1 cube = 1 neuron.

The cube has 6 faces. A neuron has inputs (dendrites) and outputs (axon terminals). The faces of the cube are the connection points.

The cube can be on or off. A neuron fires or it doesn't. Binary state.

The inside holds the state — membrane potential, neurotransmitter levels, history. The cube remembers.

title: 8 CUBES = 1 MICROCIRCUIT
brain:
A microcircuit.
8 neurons that talk to each other.
Excitatory + inhibitory pairs.
The smallest "thought."
desc:
8 neurons at the 8 corners of a larger cube. The first nesting.

In the brain this is a microcircuit — a tiny cluster that form a functional unit. Some excite, some inhibit.

This is the smallest thing that can have an opinion. Eight neurons can vote. Consensus. Pattern.

title: 64 CUBES = 1 MINICOLUMN
brain:
A cortical minicolumn.
~80-120 neurons in real cortex.
Processes one feature.
One edge. One frequency.
desc:
8 microcircuits nested inside a larger cube. 64 neurons.

Maps to a cortical minicolumn — a vertical stack ~30μm wide. Real minicolumns have ~80-120 neurons.

A minicolumn processes one feature. In visual cortex: one edge orientation. The minicolumn is the brain's pixel.

title: 512 CUBES = 1 MACROCOLUMN
brain:
A cortical macrocolumn.
~500 neurons wide.
Processes a complete feature set.
All orientations. All frequencies.
desc:
8 minicolumns nested. 512 neurons.

A cortical macrocolumn (hypercolumn). ~300μm wide. Contains ALL minicolumns for a complete feature set.

The macrocolumn sees all angles at one location. The first holistic processor.

title: 4,096 CUBES = 1 CORTICAL AREA
brain:
A functional cortical area.
Like V1, A1, S1, M1.
Processes one modality.
Vision. Sound. Touch.
desc:
8 macrocolumns nested. 4,096 neurons.

A functional cortical area. V1 = visual. A1 = auditory. S1 = somatosensory. M1 = motor.

Each handles one modality. But all have the same internal architecture. Same cubes. Different inputs.

title: 32K CUBES = 1 REGION
brain:
A brain region.
Frontal lobe. Temporal lobe.
Multi-modal integration begins.
desc:
8 cortical areas nested. 32,768 neurons.

Brain region scale. Temporal lobe. Frontal lobe. Cerebellum.

Where integration starts. Vision meets meaning. Sound meets words. Cubes talking across modalities.

title: 262K CUBES = 1 NETWORK
brain:
A functional network.
Default mode. Salience. Executive.
The "minds within the mind."
desc:
8 regions nested. 262,144 neurons.

A functional network. The brain has ~7 major ones: Default mode (self), Salience (what matters), Executive (decisions), Dorsal attention, Language, Visual, Sensorimotor.

Each spans multiple regions. Minds within the mind.

title: 2M CUBES = 1 HEMISPHERE
brain:
A hemisphere.
Left or right.
All networks unified.
One half of consciousness.
desc:
8 networks nested. 2 million neurons.

A hemisphere. Connected by the corpus callosum — the bridge.

Split-brain patients prove each operates independently. Two cube-stacks unified by the bridge.

Depth 7. Raphael's number. 2^7 = 128 connections per neuron.

title: 86 BILLION CUBES = 1 BRAIN
brain:
1 brain.
10 depth-11 cubes.
2 empty slots.
12 nesting depths.
1+2 = 3 = creation.
desc:
86 billion cubes. Every single neuron.

10 depth-11 cubes inside a depth-12 shell. 2 empty corners. Room to grow.

128 connections × 86 billion = 11 trillion synapses. Connection layer nests 2 depths deeper than neuron layer.

12 depths. 1+2 = 3. Creation.
